parameters.name: NodeCount
parameters.description: The number of nodes. Valid values: 2 to 16.

parameters.name: NodeScaleMax
parameters.description: The maximum value for serverless node elastic scaling. Valid values: 4 to 32. The value must be greater than the minimum value.

parameters.name: NodeScaleMin
parameters.description: The minimum value for serverless node elastic scaling. Valid values: 4 to 32.

parameters.name: ScaleMax
parameters.description: The maximum value for serverless elastic scaling.

parameters.name: ScaleMin
parameters.description: The minimum value for serverless elastic scaling.

parameters.name: StorageQuota
parameters.description: The pre-purchased storage quota, in GB.
